paite: Huan akiang a dinghte ma ah Joseph akidek zouta kei, “Mi tengteng ka kiang a kipan pawtkhesak vek un," chi in akikoukhia hi. Joseph asanggamte kiang a akigen sung teng akiang ah kuamah adingh kei uhi.
heading: Joseph Asanggamte Kiang Ah Akipuangkhia
english: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he cried, “Cause everyone to go out from me!” No one else stood with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

paite: Akap loloih a, Aiguptate'n aza ua, Pharaoh inkuanpihte'n leng aza uh.
english: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.

paite: Joseph in asanggamte kiang ah, "Keimah Joseph ka hi. Ka pa adam lai na maw?" achi hi. Himahleh asanggamte'n adawng thei kei ua, ama ah buaitak in a-om uhi.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?” His brothers couldn’t answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.

paite: Joseph mah in asanggamte kiang ah, "Hehpih in hon naih un," achi hi. Huchi in ava naih ua, ama'n, "Na unaupa uh Joseph, Aigupta gam a lutpih ding a na khotpa uh ka hi.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.” They came near. “He said, I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.

paite: Himahleh hiai a pai ding a na hon khot ziak un lungkham kei unla, kihehkhum tuan sam kei un. Mite hinna hondam ding in Pathian in na ma ua hon sawl masa ahi.
english: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.

paite: Hiai kum nih sung hiai gam ah kial aketa a; kum nga in asam lai hi. Huai sung in leileh a-om kei ding a, buhlak leng a-om kei ding.
english: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be neither plowing nor harvest.

paite: Tunung khang om zel ding hawisak ding leh noute hotdamna thupitak a hingdam a ka hon omsak theihna ding in Pathian in na ma uah kei ahon sawl masa hi.
english: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.

paite: Huchi in hiai a hon sawl noute na hi kei ua, Pathian ahi zaw. Ama'n Pharaoh pa in leh a-inkuanpih tengteng heutu in leh Aigupta gam tengteng vaihawmtu in ahon bawlta hi.
english: So now it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

paite: "Kintak in ka pa kiang ah va pai unla, akiang ah, na tapa Joseph in hichi in achi: Pathian in Aigupta gam tengteng heutu in ahon bawlta a, ka kiang ah hong paisuk in, sawt hon hal ke'n.
english: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.

paite: Huchi in Goshen gam ah na teng ding a, ka kiang ngei ah na om ding; nang, na tate, na tute, na belamhonte, na bawnghonte leh na neih tengteng toh.
english: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.

paite: Hiai ah keimah in ka hon vak ding; kial lah kum nga om lai ding ahi ngal a. Huchi lou in zaw nang leh na inkuanpihte leh na neih tengteng toh na kialgawp kha ding uh," hon chi un.
english: There I will nourish you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.”’

paite: "Ngai un, noumau mit ngei leh ka nau Benjamin mit ngei in keimah kam mahmah in agen lai na mu kilkel uhi.
english: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.

paite: Aigupta gam a ka thupina tengteng thu leh na thil muh tengteng thu uh ka pa na hilh ding ua; kintak in hiai ah ka pa na hon pisuk pah ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father down here.”

paite: Anau Benjamin ngawng a kun in akap a; Benjamin leng ama ngawng a kun in akap hi.
english: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.

paite: Asanggamte tengteng atawp a, akahkhum chiat a, huai khit in asanggamte'n thu vantang agenpih uhi.
english: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.

paite: Joseph sanggamte ahong uh chih thu thuthang Pharaoh inkote'n ana za uhi. Huai in Pharaoh leh asikhate akipaksak mahmah hi.
english: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

paite: Pharaoh in Joseph kiang ah, "Na sanggamte kiang ah huchi in hih in. Na gante uh buh posak unla, pawt unla, Kanaan gam ah pai un.
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this. Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.

paite: Na pa uh leh na inkuanpihte uh hon pi unla, ka kiang ah hong pai un. Aigupta gam a thil hoihte ka hon pe ding a, hiai gam a thil om hoihpente na ne ding uh.
english: Take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’

paite: Thu ka hon pia ahi, 'Hichibang in hih un: Na taneu chikchikte uh a ding leh na zite uh a ding Aigupta gam a kipan kangtalaite la unla, na pa uh pi ding in va kuan un.
english: Now you are commanded: do this. Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

paite: Na van uh leng ngaihtuah nuam dah un, Aigupta gam tengteng thil hoih peuhmah nou a ahi ngal a,' " achi hi.
english: Also, don’t concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all of the land of Egypt is yours.”

paite: Israel suante'n huchibang in ahih ua, Joseph in Pharaoh thupiak bang in akiang uah kangtalaite apia a, lampi a nek ding leng apia hi.
english: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

paite: Avek ua kiang ah puansilh kikhenna ding ape chiat a; Benjamin kiang ngial ah houh dangka zathum leh puansilh kikhenna ding nga apia hi.
english: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.

paite: Apa kiang ah hiaite akhak hi: Aigupta gam a thil hoih pua sabiltung sawmkhat leh lampi a, apa a ding buh leh tanghou leh nek ding pua sabengtungnu sawmkhat toh.
english: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.

paite: Huchi in asanggamte asawlkhia a, apaita uh. Ama'n akiang uah, "Lampi ah kina lou ding in pilvang un aw,” achi hi.
english: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan apaitou ua, huan Kanaan gam a apa uh Jakob kiang ava tungta uhi.
english: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.

paite: Akiang ah, "Joseph adam lai a, huan Aigupta gam tengteng tung ah vaihawmpa in apang," chi in ahilh uhi. Athugen uh agintak louh ziak in, alungtang abahta hi.
english: They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he didn’t believe them.

paite: Akiang ua Joseph thugente ahilh ua; atuanna ding kangtalai Joseph in akhakte amuh in Jakob lungtang ahong halh nawn hi.
english: They told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob, their father, revived.

paite: Israel in, "Ahunta; ka tapa Joseph hingdam a na om ahi maw. Ka sih ma in amah ka va mu ding,” achi hi.
english: Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”
